notes: Dome shell pane grid + meridian ribs + rings + drum windows present; finial caps the apex. Loggia band sits between the attic dentils and the portico top.
Belfry arches read on two faces, balusters under the rail, quoin strips and stage bands on both towers; pyramid caps aligned with the shaft diagonals.
Eight-column colonnade with capitals in front of the recessed glazed wall; stairs descend in three flights with landings; banners pair on the axis.
Rear-quarter view shows the ribbed half-pipe vault and the sloped canopy in the courtyard; ridge caps run all roof ridges and hips.
